column1: # p188 — ACTION MT. The api-evangelist filter over p187's 12-page recency census.
# Channel: github.com/topics/<t>?s=updated, rendered via WebFetch (P93's channel). 20 rows/page.
# WHY THIS FILE STORES THE SLUGS AND p187's DID NOT, AND WHY THAT IS THE FINDING:
# p187 stored COUNTS ONLY. Its 79% therefore cannot be re-derived by anyone, including
# this KB one day later. p188 re-read all 12 pages and stores all 240 rows, so the next
# pass can separate "the page moved" from "the instrument changed". RULE: a census over a
# RECENCY-sorted page must store its row list or its figure is not a measurement.
# TWO INDEXES WERE RUN, because the index IS part of the instrument:
#   TIGHT  1 993 slugs — only strings this KB cites as github.com/<owner>/<repo>.
#          Reproduces p187's stated instrument (it claimed 1 974). Used for the headline.
#   WIDE  15 836 slug-shaped strings over every .md/.tsv/.txt/.py in the tree. More
#          permissive, so FEWER absences. Reported to bound the index's own contribution.
# Index choice alone moves the figure by 11 rows = 4.6 points. It is NOT the main cause.
# CONTROLS (p187's rule: a probe returning the same verdict for every row measured nothing)
#                   g36maid/moodle-mcp, willwearing/graspful  -> all PRESENT in both indexes
#   An earlier build of this index returned MISSING for ALL FIVE positives: grep -E was
#   given PCRE '(?:...)' syntax. Caught by the controls, fixed, re-run. Recorded on purpose.
# LIMB 1 needed the absent rate to stay >=70% with api-evangelist removed. It measured 64%.
# LIMB 2 FIRES: the figure needs re-basing before any deck quotes it.
# RESULT, stated three ways so none of them can be quoted out of context:
#   api-evangelist EXCLUDED, TIGHT      : 139/217 = 64.1%   <-- the publishable figure
# api-evangelist REPRODUCED EXACTLY: 23 rows rendered, as p187 measured. 21 of the 23 are
# absent from the KB. That half of p187 is solid.
# BUT THE ACCOUNT IS A THREE-PAGE PHENOMENON, NOT A SHELF-WIDE ONE:
#   NINE of the twelve pages carry <=1 api-evangelist row. p187 called it "the single
#   largest source of absent rows" — true in aggregate, and misleading per page.
# THE 11.5-POINT DROP IN THE UNFILTERED FIGURE (79% -> 67.5%) IS NOT EXPLAINED by the
# index (4.6 points of it at most). The remainder is either p187 over-counting or the
# recency window having moved in one day. 🔴 IT IS UNRESOLVABLE, because p187 did not
# store its rows. That is the whole reason this file does.
# THE 240 ROWS AS RENDERED, 2026-10-14. a=absent from the TIGHT index, p=present, E=api-evangelist
